notes.title: Quick Patch
notes.content:
Some stuff was broke, now is not (or at least less) broke. Here's a real basic overview for v1.4.1

We completely replaced the movement, transitioning from the Unity Character Component to just using a rigidbody.

Our AI programmer made some edits to the enemies. They re-did targeting, pursuit, and attacking to make them a little better at their job (attacking Edward). They also made it so their corpses despawn so they don't get in the way.

We also trimmed some excess from the levels and slightly reduced the size of the build!

On a side note, this was made as a school project and made in a little less than a year. Because many of us were unable to work on this project post-college, it took us a minute or three to get this out. Thank you for your patience, hopefully, this patch fixes a lot of issues people were having and didn't introduce any new ones.

<3
- Conner
